description: This file defines the StateStorageBridge class which provides functionality for operating on grain state within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing state asynchronously, as well as handling dehydration and rehydration of grain state. The file also contains internal classes for managing shared instances and dependencies.

classes.name: StateStorageBridge`1
classes.description: Provides functionality for operating on grain state, including reading, writing, and clearing state asynchronously, as well as dehydration and rehydration handling.

classes.name: StateStorageBridgeSharedMap
classes.description: Manages shared instances of StateStorageBridgeShared for different state types and storage providers.

classes.name: StateStorageBridgeShared`1
classes.description: Holds shared information and dependencies for a specific grain state type and storage provider.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the grain state from external storage.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the grain state to external storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the grain state from external storage.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Handles dehydration by storing the current grain state into the dehydration context.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Handles rehydration by restoring grain state from the rehydration context.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles errors during storage operations, logging and wrapping exceptions as needed.
